questions.question: What were the total online sales in 2009?

questions.question: What are the top 10 most expensive products by unit price?

questions.question: What is the average unit cost across all products?

questions.question: How many stores are currently open?

questions.question: Show total sales amount by product category

questions.question: What were the monthly online sales for 2008?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT toMonth(DateKey) as month, sum(SalesAmount) as monthly_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: For each store, show total sales, average order value, and number of transactions
questions.expected_sql: SELECT s.StoreName, sum(f.SalesAmount) as total_sales, avg(f.SalesAmount) as avg_order_value, count() as num_transactions FROM retail.FactSales f JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey GROUP BY s.StoreName

questions.question: Which customers have spent more than $10,000 in total?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, sum(s.SalesAmount) as total_spent FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING sum(s.SalesAmount) > 10000

questions.question: What are the total online sales by country?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT g.RegionCountryName, sum(s.SalesAmount) as total_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey JOIN retail.DimGeography g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY g.RegionCountryName ORDER BY total_sales DESC

questions.question: Compare total online sales between 2008 and 2009
questions.expected_sql: SELECT toYear(DateKey) as year, sum(SalesAmount) as total_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: What percentage of sales occur on weekends vs weekdays?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.IsWorkDay, sum(s.SalesAmount) as sales, round(sum(s.SalesAmount) * 100.0 / (SELECT sum(SalesAmount) FROM retail.FactOnlineSales), 2) as percentage FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey GROUP BY d.IsWorkDay

questions.question: What is the total discount amount given by each promotion type?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p.PromotionType, sum(s.DiscountAmount) as total_discount FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON s.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey WHERE p.PromotionKey != 1 GROUP BY p.PromotionType

questions.question: What is the average order value by customer gender?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.Gender, avg(s.SalesAmount) as avg_order_value FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.Gender

questions.question: Which products currently have inventory below their safety stock level?
questions.expected_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(DateKey) as max_date FROM retail.FactInventory) SELECT p.ProductName, i.OnHandQuantity, i.SafetyStockQuantity FROM retail.FactInventory i JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN latest ON i.DateKey = latest.max_date WHERE i.OnHandQuantity < i.SafetyStockQuantity

questions.question: What is the current inventory level for each product in each store?
questions.expected_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, MAX(DateKey) as max_date FROM retail.FactInventory GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey) SELECT s.StoreName, p.ProductName, i.OnHandQuantity FROM retail.FactInventory i JOIN latest l ON i.StoreKey = l.StoreKey AND i.ProductKey = l.ProductKey AND i.DateKey = l.max_date JOIN retail.DimStore s ON i.StoreKey = s.StoreKey JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey

questions.question: Rank the top 5 customers by total spend in each country
questions.expected_sql: WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT c.CustomerKey, c.FirstName, c.LastName, g.RegionCountryName, sum(s.SalesAmount) as total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.RegionCountryName ORDER BY sum(s.SalesAmount) DESC) as rn FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey JOIN retail.DimGeography g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey, c.FirstName, c.LastName, g.RegionCountryName) SELECT * FROM customer_sales WHERE rn <= 5

questions.question: Show cumulative monthly sales for 2009
questions.expected_sql: SELECT toMonth(DateKey) as month, sum(SalesAmount) as monthly_sales, sum(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toMonth(DateKey)) as cumulative_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: What is the return rate by product category?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, sum(s.ReturnQuantity) as total_returns, sum(s.SalesQuantity) as total_sales, round(sum(s.ReturnQuantity) * 100.0 / nullIf(sum(s.SalesQuantity), 0), 2) as return_rate_pct FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName

questions.question: Which season has the highest average daily sales in North America?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.NorthAmericaSeason, avg(daily_sales) as avg_daily_sales FROM (SELECT DateKey, sum(SalesAmount) as daily_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY DateKey) s JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey GROUP BY d.NorthAmericaSeason ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers made their first purchase in each quarter of 2007?
questions.expected_sql: WITH first_purchase AS (SELECT CustomerKey, MIN(DateKey) as first_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey) SELECT toQuarter(first_date) as quarter, count() as new_customers FROM first_purchase WHERE toYear(first_date) = 2007 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

questions.question: What are the top 10 products by profit margin percentage?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT ProductName, UnitPrice, UnitCost, round((UnitPrice - UnitCost) * 100.0 / nullIf(UnitPrice, 0), 2) as margin_pct FROM retail.DimProduct WHERE UnitPrice > 0 ORDER BY margin_pct DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Compare average transaction value between Store and Online channels
questions.expected_sql: SELECT 'Online' as channel, avg(SalesAmount) as avg_transaction FROM retail.FactOnlineSales UNION ALL SELECT 'Store' as channel, avg(SalesAmount) FROM retail.FactSales WHERE channelKey = 1

questions.question: What percentage more or less do we sell on holidays compared to regular days?
questions.expected_sql: WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT d.DateKey, d.IsHoliday, sum(s.SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey GROUP BY d.DateKey, d.IsHoliday), avgs AS (SELECT IsHoliday, avg(sales) as avg_sales FROM daily_sales GROUP BY IsHoliday) SELECT round((h.avg_sales - r.avg_sales) * 100.0 / r.avg_sales, 2) as pct_difference FROM avgs h, avgs r WHERE h.IsHoliday = 'Yes' AND r.IsHoliday = 'No'

questions.question: Calculate a 7-day moving average of daily online sales for December 2009
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DateKey, daily_sales, avg(daily_sales) OVER (ORDER BY DateKey ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as moving_avg_7d FROM (SELECT DateKey, sum(SalesAmount) as daily_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE DateKey >= '2009-12-01' AND DateKey <= '2009-12-31' GROUP BY DateKey) ORDER BY DateKey

questions.question: Compare actual sales revenue to budget for each product category in 2009
questions.expected_sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, sum(CASE WHEN sp.ScenarioKey = 1 THEN sp.Amount ELSE 0 END) as actual, sum(CASE WHEN sp.ScenarioKey = 2 THEN sp.Amount ELSE 0 END) as budget FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan sp JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON sp.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey JOIN retail.DimAccount a ON sp.AccountKey = a.AccountKey WHERE a.AccountName = 'Sale Revenue' AND toYear(sp.DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName

questions.question: What is the total lifetime value for customers who made purchases in all 3 years?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT count() as customer_count, sum(total_ltv) as total_ltv FROM (SELECT CustomerKey, sum(SalesAmount) as total_ltv FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey HAVING count(DISTINCT toYear(DateKey)) = 3)

questions.question: Which products are most frequently purchased together in the same order?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p1.ProductName as product1, p2.ProductName as product2, count() as times_together FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s1 JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales s2 ON s1.SalesOrderNumber = s2.SalesOrderNumber AND s1.ProductKey < s2.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProduct p1 ON s1.ProductKey = p1.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProduct p2 ON s2.ProductKey = p2.ProductKey GROUP BY p1.ProductName, p2.ProductName ORDER BY times_together DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Calculate inventory turnover ratio by product for 2009
questions.expected_sql: WITH cogs AS (SELECT ProductKey, sum(TotalCost) as total_cogs FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY ProductKey), avg_inv AS (SELECT ProductKey, avg(OnHandQuantity * UnitCost) as avg_inventory FROM retail.FactInventory WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY ProductKey) SELECT p.ProductName, c.total_cogs, a.avg_inventory, round(c.total_cogs / nullIf(a.avg_inventory, 0), 2) as turnover_ratio FROM cogs c JOIN avg_inv a ON c.ProductKey = a.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON c.ProductKey = p.ProductKey ORDER BY turnover_ratio DESC

questions.question: List all employees and their manager's name
questions.expected_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.Title, m.FirstName as manager_first, m.LastName as manager_last FROM retail.DimEmployee e LEFT JOIN retail.DimEmployee m ON e.ParentEmployeeKey = m.EmployeeKey

questions.question: Classify customers into Active, At Risk, and Churned based on recency
questions.expected_sql: WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(DateKey) as data_end FROM retail.FactOnlineSales), customer_last AS (SELECT CustomerKey, MAX(DateKey) as last_purchase FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey) SELECT CASE WHEN dateDiff('month', cl.last_purchase, md.data_end) <= 6 THEN 'Active' WHEN dateDiff('month', cl.last_purchase, md.data_end) <= 12 THEN 'At Risk' ELSE 'Churned' END as segment, count() as customers FROM customer_last cl, max_date md GROUP BY segment

questions.question: Show each store's total sales and its percentile rank
questions.expected_sql: SELECT s.StoreName, sum(f.SalesAmount) as total_sales, round(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sum(f.SalesAmount)) * 100, 2) as percentile FROM retail.FactSales f JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName ORDER BY total_sales DESC

questions.question: How accurate were the sales forecasts compared to actuals for Q4 2009?
questions.expected_sql: WITH actuals AS (SELECT ProductCategoryKey, sum(Amount) as actual FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan WHERE ScenarioKey = 1 AND DateKey >= '2009-10-01' AND DateKey <= '2009-12-31' AND AccountKey = 4 GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey), forecasts AS (SELECT ProductCategoryKey, sum(Amount) as forecast FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan WHERE ScenarioKey = 3 AND DateKey >= '2009-10-01' AND DateKey <= '2009-12-31' AND AccountKey = 4 GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey) SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, a.actual, f.forecast, round(abs(a.actual - f.forecast) * 100.0 / nullIf(a.actual, 0), 2) as error_pct FROM actuals a JOIN forecasts f ON a.ProductCategoryKey = f.ProductCategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON a.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey

questions.question: Analyze if new product introductions affected existing product sales by subcategory
questions.expected_sql:
-- This requires identifying new products by AvailableForSaleDate and comparing before/after sales
WITH new_products AS (SELECT ProductSubcategoryKey, MIN(toDate(AvailableForSaleDate)) as first_new FROM retail.DimProduct WHERE AvailableForSaleDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ProductSubcategoryKey HAVING MIN(toDate(AvailableForSaleDate)) > '2007-06-01'), existing_sales AS (SELECT p.ProductSubcategoryKey AS ProductSubcategoryKey, CASE WHEN s.DateKey < np.first_new THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END as period, sum(s.SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN new_products np ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = np.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate) < np.first_new GROUP BY p.ProductSubcategoryKey, period) SELECT ps.ProductSubcategoryName, sum(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN sales END) as before_sales, sum(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN sales END) as after_sales FROM existing_sales es JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON es.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey GROUP BY ps.ProductSubcategoryName

questions.question: What would online sales have been in EUR using end-of-day exchange rates?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(s.SalesAmount * er.EndOfDayRate) as sales_eur FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate er ON s.DateKey = er.DateKey AND s.CurrencyKey = er.CurrencyKey JOIN retail.DimCurrency c ON er.CurrencyKey = c.CurrencyKey WHERE c.CurrencyName = 'EUR'

questions.question: What were last quarter's sales?

-- Ambiguous: assuming last quarter of available data (Q4 2009)
SELECT sum(SalesAmount) FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE DateKey >= '2009-10-01' AND DateKey <= '2009-12-31'

questions.question: How is the Cameras category performing?
questions.expected_sql:
-- Ambiguous: interpreting as sales trend
SELECT toYear(s.DateKey) as year, sum(s.SalesAmount) as sales, sum(s.SalesAmount) - lag(sum(s.SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(s.DateKey)) as yoy_change FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey WHERE pc.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras and camcorders' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: Show me the gross margin by region
questions.expected_sql:
-- Interpreting gross margin as (SalesAmount - TotalCost), region as continent
SELECT g.ContinentName as region, sum(s.SalesAmount) - sum(s.TotalCost) as gross_margin FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey JOIN retail.DimGeography g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY g.ContinentName

questions.question: Are online sales growing?
questions.expected_sql:
-- Interpreting as year-over-year growth
SELECT toYear(DateKey) as year, sum(SalesAmount) as sales, round((sum(SalesAmount) - lag(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey))) * 100.0 / lag(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey)), 2) as growth_pct FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: Which stores have the best sales per square foot?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT s.StoreName, sum(f.SalesAmount) as total_sales, s.SellingAreaSize, round(sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullIf(s.SellingAreaSize, 0), 2) as sales_per_sqft FROM retail.FactSales f JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey WHERE s.SellingAreaSize IS NOT NULL AND s.SellingAreaSize > 0 GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName, s.SellingAreaSize ORDER BY sales_per_sqft DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: What's our most profitable customer segment?
questions.expected_sql:
-- Interpreting segment as education level, profitable as total profit
SELECT c.Education as segment, sum(s.SalesAmount - s.TotalCost) as profit FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey WHERE c.Education IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Education ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What's the average machine downtime per store?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT s.StoreName, avg(i.DownTime) as avg_downtime_minutes FROM retail.FactITSLA i JOIN retail.DimStore s ON i.StoreKey = s.StoreKey WHERE i.DownTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName ORDER BY avg_downtime_minutes DESC

questions.question: Is there a correlation between IT outages and sales performance?
questions.expected_sql:
-- Complex: comparing stores with high outages vs low outages
WITH store_outages AS (SELECT StoreKey, count() as outage_count, sum(DownTime) as total_downtime FROM retail.FactITSLA GROUP BY StoreKey), store_sales AS (SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmount) as total_sales FROM retail.FactSales GROUP BY StoreKey) SELECT CASE WHEN so.total_downtime > 1000 THEN 'High Downtime' ELSE 'Low Downtime' END as downtime_group, avg(ss.total_sales) as avg_sales, count() as store_count FROM store_outages so JOIN store_sales ss ON so.StoreKey = ss.StoreKey GROUP BY downtime_group

questions.question: Roll up sales to the entity hierarchy level
questions.expected_sql:
-- Using FactStrategyPlan which has EntityKey linkage
WITH RECURSIVE entity_tree AS (SELECT EntityKey, EntityName, ParentEntityKey, EntityKey as root_key FROM retail.DimEntity WHERE ParentEntityKey IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.EntityKey, e.EntityName, e.ParentEntityKey, t.root_key FROM retail.DimEntity e JOIN entity_tree t ON e.ParentEntityKey = t.EntityKey) SELECT et.EntityName, sum(sp.Amount) as total_amount FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan sp JOIN entity_tree et ON sp.EntityKey = et.EntityKey WHERE sp.ScenarioKey = 1 AND sp.AccountKey = 4 GROUP BY et.EntityName

questions.question: What's the same-store sales growth comparing 2009 to 2008?
questions.expected_sql: WITH stores_both_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009), sales_2008 AS (SELECT sum(SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM stores_both_years)), sales_2009 AS (SELECT sum(SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM stores_both_years)) SELECT s9.sales as sales_2009, s8.sales as sales_2008, round((s9.sales - s8.sales) * 100.0 / s8.sales, 2) as growth_pct FROM sales_2009 s9, sales_2008 s8

questions.question: Which product subcategories generated more than $1 million in online sales in 2009?

questions.question: For each product brand, show total online revenue and units sold in 2008, listing only brands with at least 500 units.

questions.question: Show monthly online gross margin dollars and margin percent for 2009.

questions.question: Which store managers run stores with more than $5M in total all-channel sales?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT s.StoreManager, s.StoreName, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS total_sales FROM retail.FactSales f JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey GROUP BY s.StoreManager, s.StoreName HAVING total_sales > 5000000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 50

questions.question: What's the total discount amount given in each quarter of 2009 (excluding no-discount transactions)?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT toQuarter(DateKey) AS quarter, sum(DiscountAmount) AS total_discount, countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) AS discounted_orders FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND PromotionKey <> 1 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

questions.question: Which product colors have the highest average online unit price realized, among colors with at least 1000 units sold?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p.ColorName, sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) AS avg_realized_price, sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS units FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey GROUP BY p.ColorName HAVING units >= 1000 ORDER BY avg_realized_price DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many online orders were placed on holidays vs non-holidays in 2009, and the revenue for each?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.IsHoliday, countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber) AS orders, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY d.IsHoliday

questions.question: Which promotion categories drove the most discounted online revenue, and what average discount percent did they achieve?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT pr.PromotionCategory, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue, sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS total_discount, sum(f.DiscountAmount) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount + f.DiscountAmount), 0) AS avg_discount_pct FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f JOIN retail.DimPromotion pr ON f.PromotionKey = pr.PromotionKey WHERE f.PromotionKey <> 1 GROUP BY pr.PromotionCategory ORDER BY revenue DESC

questions.question: For each store type, what are the total all-channel sales and average selling area size?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT s.StoreType, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue, avg(s.SellingAreaSize) AS avg_area, countDistinct(f.StoreKey) AS stores FROM retail.FactSales f JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey GROUP BY s.StoreType ORDER BY revenue DESC

questions.question: For each product category, which subcategory had the highest online sales in 2009, and what was that amount?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS category, psc.ProductSubcategoryName AS subcategory,
         sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY sum(f.SalesAmount) DESC) AS rn
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON psc.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
  WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, psc.ProductSubcategoryName
)
SELECT category, subcategory, round(sales, 2) AS sales_amount
FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

questions.question: Show the running cumulative total of online sales by quarter across 2007-2009.
questions.expected_sql:
SELECT toYear(DateKey) AS year, toQuarter(DateKey) AS quarter,
       round(sum(SalesAmount), 2) AS quarterly_sales,
       round(sum(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey), toQuarter(DateKey) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS cumulative_sales
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
GROUP BY year, quarter
ORDER BY year, quarter

questions.question: Which 10 products have the largest gap between their current on-hand inventory and safety stock level?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, MAX(DateKey) AS max_date
  FROM retail.FactInventory
  GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
)
SELECT p.ProductName,
       sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS total_on_hand,
       sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS total_safety,
       sum(i.OnHandQuantity) - sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS gap
FROM retail.FactInventory i
JOIN latest l ON i.StoreKey = l.StoreKey AND i.ProductKey = l.ProductKey AND i.DateKey = l.max_date
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
GROUP BY p.ProductName
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10
tricky_aspects: aggregation across stores for the gap

questions.question: For each store, rank the top 3 products by sales in 2009 and show each product's share of the store's total.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH prod_store AS (
  SELECT f.StoreKey, f.ProductKey, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY f.StoreKey, f.ProductKey
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, sales,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY sales DESC) AS rn,
         sum(sales) OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey) AS store_total
  FROM prod_store
)
SELECT s.StoreName, p.ProductName, round(r.sales, 2) AS product_sales,
       round(r.sales * 100.0 / nullif(r.store_total, 0), 2) AS pct_of_store
FROM ranked r
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON r.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON r.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY s.StoreName, r.rn
LIMIT 50
tricky_aspects: two window functions (rank and partition total)

questions.question: Which customers increased their spending by more than 50% from 2008 to 2009?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey,
         sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS y2008,
         sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS y2009
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName,
       round(y.y2008, 2) AS spend_2008,
       round(y.y2009, 2) AS spend_2009,
       round((y.y2009 - y.y2008) * 100.0 / nullif(y.y2008, 0), 2) AS pct_growth
FROM yearly y
JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON y.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE y.y2008 > 0 AND (y.y2009 - y.y2008) / nullif(y.y2008, 0) > 0.5
ORDER BY pct_growth DESC
LIMIT 25

questions.question: For each product category, what percentage of total online sales came from repeat customers (customers with 2+ orders)?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) AS n_orders
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS category,
       round(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, co.n_orders >= 2) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0), 2) AS pct_repeat_customer_sales
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN cust_orders co ON f.CustomerKey = co.CustomerKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON psc.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY pct_repeat_customer_sales DESC

questions.question: For each month in 2009, what is the month-over-month growth rate of online sales?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT toMonth(DateKey) AS month, sum(SalesAmount) AS sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       round(sales, 2) AS sales,
       round(lagInFrame(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS prev_month_sales,
       round((sales - lagInFrame(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / nullif(lagInFrame(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

questions.question: Rank promotion categories by total discount amount given in 2009, and show each one's share of all discounts.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT pr.PromotionCategory AS category, sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS disc
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimPromotion pr ON f.PromotionKey = pr.PromotionKey
  WHERE f.PromotionKey != 1 AND toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category,
       round(disc, 2) AS discount_total,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY disc DESC) AS rnk,
       round(disc * 100.0 / nullif(sum(disc) OVER (), 0), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM promo
ORDER BY rnk

questions.question: Which 10 stores had the highest sales-to-quota attainment in 2009?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH actuals AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
  FROM retail.FactSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY StoreKey
),
quotas AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS quota
  FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND ScenarioKey = 1
  GROUP BY StoreKey
)
SELECT s.StoreName,
       round(a.actual_sales, 2) AS actual_sales,
       round(q.quota, 2) AS quota,
       round(a.actual_sales * 100.0 / nullif(q.quota, 0), 2) AS attainment_pct
FROM actuals a
JOIN quotas q ON a.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON a.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE q.quota > 0
ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC
LIMIT 10

questions.question: For each country, what is the average days between a customer's first and most recent purchase?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, MIN(DateKey) AS first_d, MAX(DateKey) AS last_d
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT g.RegionCountryName AS country,
       count(*) AS n_customers,
       round(avg(dateDiff('day', cust.first_d, cust.last_d)), 1) AS avg_active_days
FROM cust
JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON cust.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
JOIN retail.DimGeography g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
WHERE cust.first_d != cust.last_d
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY avg_active_days DESC
LIMIT 20

questions.question: Compute the average customer lifetime value broken down by the year each customer first made a purchase, and include how many customers fall into each cohort.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toYear(MIN(DateKey)) AS cohort_year
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
customer_spend AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, SUM(SalesAmount) AS lifetime_spend
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
joined AS (
  SELECT f.cohort_year, c.lifetime_spend
  FROM first_purchase f
  JOIN customer_spend c USING (CustomerKey)
)
SELECT cohort_year,
       count() AS customers_in_cohort,
       round(avg(lifetime_spend), 2) AS avg_ltv,
       round(sum(lifetime_spend), 2) AS total_ltv
FROM joined
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year

questions.question: For each manager with direct reports, show how many people they manage and the average hire tenure of their team in years.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH reports AS (
  SELECT ParentEmployeeKey AS mgr_key,
         count() AS direct_reports,
         avg(dateDiff('year', toDate(HireDate), toDate('2009-12-31'))) AS avg_tenure_years
  FROM retail.DimEmployee
  WHERE ParentEmployeeKey IS NOT NULL AND HireDate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mgr_key
)
SELECT m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS manager_name,
       m.Title,
       r.direct_reports,
       round(r.avg_tenure_years, 1) AS avg_team_tenure_years
FROM reports r
JOIN retail.DimEmployee m ON m.EmployeeKey = toInt32(r.mgr_key)
ORDER BY r.direct_reports DESC, manager_name
LIMIT 25

questions.question: Show the year-over-year retention: of customers who first bought in 2007, how many came back in 2008, and of those how many came back again in 2009?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH first_yr AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toYear(MIN(DateKey)) AS first_year
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
cohort_2007 AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey FROM first_yr WHERE first_year = 2007
),
active AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toYear(DateKey) AS y
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM cohort_2007)
  GROUP BY CustomerKey, y
)
SELECT (SELECT count() FROM cohort_2007) AS cohort_size_2007,
       countDistinctIf(CustomerKey, y = 2008) AS returned_2008,
       round(countDistinctIf(CustomerKey, y = 2008) * 100.0 / (SELECT count() FROM cohort_2007), 2) AS retention_2008_pct,
       countDistinctIf(CustomerKey, y = 2008 AND CustomerKey IN (
           SELECT CustomerKey FROM active WHERE y = 2009
       )) AS returned_2008_and_2009,
       round(countDistinctIf(CustomerKey, y = 2009) * 100.0 / (SELECT count() FROM cohort_2007), 2) AS retention_2009_pct
FROM active

questions.question: Perform ABC analysis on products for 2009: identify the 'A' products (top 80% of revenue), 'B' (next 15%), and 'C' (remaining 5%), and report how many products fall in each class.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH prod_rev AS (
  SELECT ProductKey, SUM(SalesAmount) AS rev
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ProductKey, rev,
         SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_rev,
         SUM(rev) OVER () AS total_rev
  FROM prod_rev
),
classed AS (
  SELECT ProductKey,
         CASE WHEN cum_rev / total_rev <= 0.80 THEN 'A'
              WHEN cum_rev / total_rev <= 0.95 THEN 'B'
              ELSE 'C' END AS abc_class,
         rev
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT abc_class,
       count() AS product_count,
       round(sum(rev), 2) AS revenue,
       round(sum(rev) * 100.0 / (SELECT sum(rev) FROM prod_rev), 2) AS pct_of_revenue
FROM classed
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class

questions.question: Calculate each store's 2009 quota attainment: actual sales divided by sales amount quota, and list the top and bottom 5 performers.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH quotas AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, SUM(SalesAmountQuota) AS quota_amt
  FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND ScenarioKey = 2
  GROUP BY StoreKey
),
actuals AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, SUM(SalesAmount) AS actual_amt
  FROM retail.FactSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY StoreKey
),
perf AS (
  SELECT s.StoreName, a.actual_amt, q.quota_amt,
         round(a.actual_amt * 100.0 / nullif(q.quota_amt, 0), 2) AS attainment_pct
  FROM actuals a
  JOIN quotas q USING (StoreKey)
  JOIN retail.DimStore s ON s.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
  WHERE q.quota_amt > 0
)
SELECT * FROM (
  (SELECT 'TOP' AS bucket, StoreName, actual_amt, quota_amt, attainment_pct FROM perf ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC LIMIT 5)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 'BOTTOM' AS bucket, StoreName, actual_amt, quota_amt, attainment_pct FROM perf ORDER BY attainment_pct ASC LIMIT 5)
) ORDER BY bucket, attainment_pct DESC

questions.question: Analyze the relationship between discount depth and sales volume: for each product subcategory, show the correlation between promotion discount percent and sales quantity in 2009.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH enriched AS (
  SELECT psc.ProductSubcategoryName,
         p.DiscountPercent,
         fos.SalesQuantity
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales fos
  JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON p.PromotionKey = fos.PromotionKey
  JOIN retail.DimProduct dp ON dp.ProductKey = fos.ProductKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory psc ON toInt32(dp.ProductSubcategoryKey) = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
  WHERE toYear(fos.DateKey) = 2009 AND p.DiscountPercent IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT ProductSubcategoryName,
         corr(DiscountPercent, SalesQuantity) AS discount_qty_corr,
         count() AS observations
  FROM enriched
  GROUP BY ProductSubcategoryName
  HAVING observations > 100
)
SELECT ProductSubcategoryName,
       round(discount_qty_corr, 3) AS corr_discount_vs_qty,
       observations
FROM stats
ORDER BY discount_qty_corr DESC
LIMIT 20

questions.question: Calculate days-of-inventory-coverage per product: current on-hand quantity divided by average daily sales quantity in the last 90 days of 2009. Show the 20 products with the lowest coverage.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, MAX(DateKey) AS max_date
  FROM retail.FactInventory GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
),
current_inv AS (
  SELECT i.ProductKey, SUM(i.OnHandQuantity) AS on_hand
  FROM retail.FactInventory i
  JOIN latest l ON i.StoreKey = l.StoreKey AND i.ProductKey = l.ProductKey AND i.DateKey = l.max_date
  GROUP BY i.ProductKey
),
recent_sales AS (
  SELECT ProductKey,
         SUM(SalesQuantity) / 90.0 AS avg_daily_qty
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE DateKey BETWEEN toDate('2009-10-03') AND toDate('2009-12-31')
  GROUP BY ProductKey
  HAVING avg_daily_qty > 0
)
SELECT p.ProductName,
       c.on_hand,
       round(r.avg_daily_qty, 2) AS avg_daily_qty,
       round(c.on_hand / r.avg_daily_qty, 1) AS days_of_coverage
FROM current_inv c
JOIN recent_sales r USING (ProductKey)
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = c.ProductKey
ORDER BY days_of_coverage ASC
LIMIT 20

questions.question: Identify loyal customers who made at least one purchase in every quarter of 2009, and show their total spend ranked highest to lowest (top 20).
questions.expected_sql:
WITH cust_q AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toQuarter(DateKey) AS q
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY CustomerKey, q
),
loyal AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey
  FROM cust_q GROUP BY CustomerKey HAVING count(distinct q) = 4
),
spend AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, SUM(SalesAmount) AS spend_2009
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM loyal)
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name,
       round(s.spend_2009, 2) AS total_spend_2009
FROM spend s
JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey = s.CustomerKey
ORDER BY s.spend_2009 DESC
LIMIT 20

questions.question: For each customer, classify them as Active, At Risk, or Churned based on recency, then compute average spend and product variety (distinct products purchased) per segment.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH cust_recency AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey,
         MAX(DateKey) AS last_purchase,
         SUM(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
         countDistinct(ProductKey) AS distinct_products
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT *,
         dateDiff('month', last_purchase, toDate('2009-12-31')) AS months_inactive,
         CASE
           WHEN dateDiff('month', last_purchase, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 6 THEN 'Active'
           WHEN dateDiff('month', last_purchase, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 12 THEN 'At Risk'
           ELSE 'Churned'
         END AS segment
  FROM cust_recency
)
SELECT segment,
       count() AS customers,
       round(avg(total_spend), 2) AS avg_spend,
       round(avg(distinct_products), 1) AS avg_distinct_products
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY CASE segment WHEN 'Active' THEN 1 WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

questions.question: Compute the gross margin percentage trend by product category across 2007, 2008, and 2009 and show the year-over-year change in margin in percentage points.
questions.expected_sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS category,
         toYear(fos.DateKey) AS y,
         SUM(fos.SalesAmount) AS rev,
         SUM(fos.TotalCost) AS cost
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales fos
  JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = fos.ProductKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory psc ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = psc.ProductCategoryKey
  GROUP BY category, y
),
margins AS (
  SELECT category, y, (rev - cost) * 100.0 / nullif(rev, 0) AS margin_pct FROM yearly
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT category,
         anyIf(margin_pct, y = 2007) AS m_2007,
         anyIf(margin_pct, y = 2008) AS m_2008,
         anyIf(margin_pct, y = 2009) AS m_2009
  FROM margins GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category,
       round(m_2007, 2) AS margin_2007_pct,
       round(m_2008, 2) AS margin_2008_pct,
       round(m_2009, 2) AS margin_2009_pct,
       round(m_2008 - m_2007, 2) AS delta_08_07_pp,
       round(m_2009 - m_2008, 2) AS delta_09_08_pp
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY m_2009 DESC

questions.question: Is there a relationship between a customer's yearly income and how much they spend online?
questions.expected_sql:
SELECT corr(c.YearlyIncome, cust_spend.total_spend) AS income_spend_correlation,
       count() AS customers_analyzed
FROM (

  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey

JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey = cust_spend.CustomerKey

questions.question: Which product brands were our most profitable last quarter?
questions.expected_sql:
SELECT p.BrandName,
       sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue,
       sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS gross_margin_dollars,
       sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
WHERE f.DateKey BETWEEN toDate('2009-10-01') AND toDate('2009-12-31')
  AND p.BrandName IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.BrandName
ORDER BY gross_margin_dollars DESC
LIMIT 10

questions.question: Is there evidence of price elasticity — do bigger discount percentages actually move more units across our promotions?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH promo_stats AS (
  SELECT f.PromotionKey,
         dp.DiscountPercent,
         sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS units_sold,
         sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimPromotion dp ON dp.PromotionKey = f.PromotionKey
  WHERE f.PromotionKey <> 1 AND dp.DiscountPercent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.PromotionKey, dp.DiscountPercent
)
SELECT corr(DiscountPercent, units_sold) AS discount_qty_correlation,
       corr(DiscountPercent, revenue) AS discount_revenue_correlation,
       count() AS promos_analyzed
FROM promo_stats

questions.question: Which of our stores look like they're losing momentum going into year-end — sales trending down from Q3 to Q4 2009?
questions.expected_sql:
SELECT s.StoreName,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 3) AS q3_sales,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 4) AS q4_sales,
       (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 4) - sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 3))
         * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 3), 0) AS qoq_pct_change
FROM retail.FactSales f
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON s.StoreKey = f.StoreKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName
HAVING q3_sales > 0 AND qoq_pct_change < 0
ORDER BY qoq_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 20
tricky_aspects: All-channel FactSales because it's about stores

questions.question: How much incremental revenue do our promotions actually drive per product category compared to what we sell at full price?
questions.expected_sql:
SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey <> 1) AS promo_revenue,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1) AS full_price_revenue,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey <> 1) / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1), 0) AS promo_to_fullprice_ratio,
       sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS total_discount_given
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY promo_to_fullprice_ratio DESC
tricky_aspects: Incremental framing requires promo vs non-promo split
Product category requires two-hop subcategory join

questions.question: For each yearly customer cohort, what fraction actually came back and bought again in a later year?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH first_year AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toYear(min(DateKey)) AS first_year
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
years_active AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, countDistinct(toYear(DateKey)) AS years_with_activity
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT fy.first_year AS cohort_year,
       count() AS cohort_size,
       countIf(ya.years_with_activity > 1) AS returning_customers,
       countIf(ya.years_with_activity > 1) * 100.0 / count() AS retention_pct
FROM first_year fy
JOIN years_active ya ON ya.CustomerKey = fy.CustomerKey
GROUP BY fy.first_year
ORDER BY cohort_year
tricky_aspects: Repeat-purchase means appearing in later year
Customers in 2009 cohort can't retain (no future years)

questions.question: Which products had the biggest second-half comeback in 2009 — meaning H2 sales dramatically exceeded H1?
questions.expected_sql:
SELECT p.ProductName,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) <= 6) AS h1_sales,
       sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) >= 7) AS h2_sales,
       (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) >= 7) - sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) <= 6))
         * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) <= 6), 0) AS h2_vs_h1_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
HAVING h1_sales >= 1000 AND h2_sales > h1_sales
ORDER BY h2_vs_h1_pct DESC
LIMIT 15
tricky_aspects: Filters noise by requiring baseline H1 sales

questions.question: Which product categories depend most heavily on a single quarter for their annual sales?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH cat_q AS (
  SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,
         toQuarter(f.DateKey) AS q,
         sum(f.SalesAmount) AS q_sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
  WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, q
)
SELECT ProductCategoryName,
       max(q_sales) / sum(q_sales) * 100 AS peak_quarter_share_pct,
       argMax(q, q_sales) AS peak_quarter
FROM cat_q
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY peak_quarter_share_pct DESC

questions.question: For each product category, how much bigger is an average weekend day compared to an average weekday?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,
         f.DateKey,
         d.IsWorkDay,
         sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimDate d ON d.DateKey = f.DateKey
  JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
  GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, f.DateKey, d.IsWorkDay
)
SELECT ProductCategoryName,
       avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
       avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS avg_weekday_sales,
       (avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'))
         * 100.0 / nullif(avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 0) AS weekend_lift_pct
FROM daily
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY weekend_lift_pct DESC

questions.question: Who are our true power customers — people who are both in the top 10% by order count AND top 10% by average order size?
questions.expected_sql:
WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey,
         countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) AS orders,
         sum(SalesAmount) / nullif(countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS aov
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
thresholds AS (
  SELECT quantile(0.9)(orders) AS orders_p90,
         quantile(0.9)(aov) AS aov_p90
  FROM cust
)
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name,
       cu.orders,
       cu.aov,
       cu.orders * cu.aov AS lifetime_value
FROM cust cu
CROSS JOIN thresholds t
JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey = cu.CustomerKey
WHERE cu.orders >= t.orders_p90 AND cu.aov >= t.aov_p90
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC
LIMIT 30
tricky_aspects: Quantile thresholds computed globally then filtered
